name: Regthar Deathgate
summary: In the Barrens, Regthar Deathgate calls seasoned Horde fighters west. The veteran warrior is gathering volunteers for a campaign across the mountains into Desolace, where centaur clans terrorize the frontier.

sections.title: Call of the Warchief's Lieutenants
sections.body: Horde leaders watch the borders for threats. In the Barrens, Regthar Deathgate has set up a defensive post guarding the western passes. Horde officers send proven adventurers west of the Crossroads to answer his call for hardened fighters.

sections.title: The Road to Desolace
sections.body: Regthar Deathgate waits in a fortified redoubt along the ridges west of the Crossroads. From there, he watches the mountain trails into Desolace. He is gathering a vanguard to cross hostile ground and strike the Kolkar and other warring centaur clans before their expansion threatens Horde territory.

faq.answer: Regthar Deathgate is an orc warrior and Horde commander stationed in the Barrens. He directs scouts and military strikes into Desolace.
Regthar Deathgate is in the Barrens, inside the Horde bunkers on the hill path west of the Crossroads, overlooking the western mountain pass.

faq.q: Who gives the quest to seek out Regthar?
faq.answer: Shadow Hunter Vol'jin, Nazgrel, Belgrom Rockmaul, and Krusk offer the call to seek Regthar. Vol'jin, Nazgrel, and Belgrom Rockmaul are in Orgrimmar; Krusk is in Tarren Mill.

faq.q: What is the primary objective of Regthar's mission?
faq.answer: Regthar is gathering warriors to cross the mountains into Desolace and attack the hostile centaur clans, especially the Kolkar.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned with Desolace?
faq.answer: Aggressive centaur clans overrun Desolace. If left unchecked, their raids could cross the mountains into the Barrens and nearby Horde settlements.

faq.q: What comes next after speaking with Regthar Deathgate?
faq.answer: After you report to Regthar, he briefs you on the lands beyond the western mountains and sends you on your first strike across the border against the Kolkar.

angles.text: The Horde is trying to secure its frontier by subduing centaur in neighboring Desolace before they can raid deeper into the Barrens.
As a tauren, you have a personal stake in helping Regthar strike against the Kolkar, after generations of conflict with the centaur across central Kalimdor.
As a warrior, you can answer Regthar's call with direct fighting skill and discipline in Desolace's hostile badlands.
